They sit atop saddles on the backs of the large rodents, which move steadily through the flowing water. The sunlight filters through the green canopy above, creating a cinematic, dappled lighting effect on the water's surface and the characters. (2) As the knights progress through the river, the camera performs a slow tracking pan from right to left, following the movement of the group. The capybaras' legs churn the water, creating white splashes and spreading ripples around their thick fur. The knights hold long lances upright, each adorned with a small white flag bearing a red cross, which flutters slightly in the air. The surrounding environment is filled with moss-covered boulders, dense ferns, and ancient trees, emphasizing the surreal, fantasy nature of the journey. (3) The movement remains consistent and calm throughout the shot, with no sudden cuts or transitions. The focus remains on the texture of the animals' fur and the metallic sheen of the armor as they move deeper into the forest. The background remains a beautifully rendered, soft-focus woodland scene, while the foreground shows the clear, moving water of the stream and the naturalistic motion of the capybaras as they navigate the rocky bed.
